question: A menu opens with a €95 tasting menu almost nobody orders. Why is it there?
answer: The expensive item sets the scale everything else is read against. Its job is not to sell; it is to make the middle of the menu feel like restraint. Remove it and the same €40 dish starts to feel expensive.
move: The dish nobody orders is doing most of the work on the menu.
trap: Assuming a price is there to be paid.
